## Checklist

- [ ] Content follows the style guidelines in `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] Recommendations include the reasoning behind them (not just "use X")
- [ ] No vendor promotion without technical justification
- [ ] New examples follow the 5-section structure (Context, Prompt, Output, Decisions, Watch Out For)
- [ ] New anti-patterns follow the 4-field structure (What it looks like, Why it happens, Why it fails, Fix)
